create_finetune_dataset: run the script to convert ASE atoms files into ASE database format for fine-tuning ML models
compute_normalizer_and_linear_reference: compute force RMS normalizer and linear reference coefficients from an ASE database training dataset
extract_energy_and_forces: extract energy and forces from an ASE atoms object at a given dataset index
compute_lin_ref: compute linear reference coefficients from atomic numbers and energies using least squares regression
launch_processing: launch parallel processing to convert ASE atoms files into ASE database files with metadata logging
